note: Public-transport mentions transcribed from the walkthethames guide's per-settlement descriptions. Only settlements where transport is explicitly described in the guide's prose are included. An absent settlement (e.g. Oxford, Henley, Marlow, Windsor) means the extract did not surface a mention, NOT that no service exists — verify against the guide before treating an absence as authoritative. Distances are along the Thames Path (walker's route), not the river.
guide_silences: Verified 2026-08-24 by targeted re-fetch — the following settlements have well-known stations but the guide's prose contains no public-transport mention: Abingdon, Wallingford, Benson, Henley, Marlow, Eton and Windsor, Walton. These are genuine gaps in the source, not extraction misses. If transport for those is wanted, source it elsewhere (OSM, hand-add) rather than re-reading this guide.
